en.t: I study the Kinko school of shakuhachi.

units.source_text: 难得月色这么宜人，我想，可能的话，就在金阁上吹它几曲，

en.t: Since the moonlight is so unusually pleasant, I thought that, if possible, I would play a few pieces up on the Golden Pavilion,

units.source_text: 于是就来了，还可以顺便教教你……"

en.t: so I came here, and I can teach you a little while I am at it..."
